calls.reason: Valmeekam et al. show standalone GPT-4 planning was weak in 2023. But the LLM+P hybrid solved most blocks-world problems, and no study tested the full SHRDLU-style mix of dialogue and state tracking, so the evidence is mixed.

This is an open-ended forecast with no deadline. OpenAI says hallucinations still occur, and some impossibility results exist, but they rest on limited assumptions. Kalai and Vempala note that some kinds of hallucination may be reducible.
Studies from 2023 show poor LLM planning, around 34% on Blocksworld, but none shows that missing world models cause it. The Othello-GPT probing work and the RAP results cut against a blanket claim.
No independent transcript or image of the kitchen exchange was found. The only record is the speakers' own account, which cannot prove itself.
